articles.title: Prosecutors accuse port chief of taking bribes; he denies wrongdoing
articles.description: Regional prosecutors on Tuesday alleged that harbour director Tomas Varga accepted payments from a shipping firm. Varga denied the allegation through his lawyer.

articles.title: "We will not raise fares this year," transit minister says
articles.description: Transit minister Lena Okafor told parliament the government would keep rail fares frozen until January, citing lower energy costs.

articles.title: Mayor resigns after audit
articles.description: Mayor Petra Lind stepped down on Friday. She said the audit findings made her position untenable.

articles.title: Northwind Ferries (NWF) suspends Baltic route
articles.description: NWF said storms forced the suspension; the company expects sailings to resume next week.

articles.title: Health agency says no link found between vaccine and outbreak
articles.description: The national health agency said its review found no evidence connecting the vaccine to the regional measles outbreak.

articles.title: Factory fire killed three, officials say
articles.description: Officials initially reported three deaths but later corrected the toll to two, saying one worker had been found alive in hospital.

articles.title: Photo gallery: autumn in the old town
Officials may delay election, sources say
articles.description: Two officials, speaking anonymously, said the electoral commission could postpone the vote by up to a month because of ballot printing problems.
